pages.text: The Wireless Grid is a portable version of the regular Grid that allows you to access your storage network from anywhere within range of a Wireless Transmitter.

To use the Wireless Grid:$(li)Right-click while holding it to open the interface$(li)Insert a Network Card to connect to a wireless network$(li)Use it within range of a configured Wireless Transmitter$(li)Access and manage your items just like a regular Grid
The Wireless Grid supports all the same features as a regular Grid, including:$(li)Viewing and managing items$(li)Searching and filtering$(li)Sorting and grouping$(li)Using Grid Filters
